Pulse Polio Drive Exceeds Targets in Telangana, Continues Elsewhere

A Pulse Polio vaccination drive in Telangana has successfully surpassed its target, immunizing 101.4% of eligible children. The campaign is also ongoing in other regions, such as Kapurthala. These efforts are part of India's broader public health initiatives to eradicate polio.
